Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a full piano roll, MIDI event editing, hardware input and output, and local SoundFont audition. Includes MIDI Workbench, Soulweaver Studio, native ensembles, Showmaster, the native Performance HUD toggle, and MP4 concert capture.
Changelog: Added STUDIO → MIDI Editor with piano roll editing, controller and expression lanes, tempo and meter tools, markers, local SoundFont audition, and Windows MIDI input, output and recording.
